scope: xyz_encoding.embeddings only, every allocated level row; temporal/MLP/Gaussians unchanged

quantization.scope: one min/max over complete xyz matrix, both channels/all levels, NOT level-wise
quantization.dequantization: existing codec.dequantize float64 affine, clip, cast float32

artifacts: NumPy NPZ; RAW8 np.savez ZIP_STORED; ZLIB8 np.savez_compressed ZIP_DEFLATED default; one array per level and UTF8 canonical JSON metadata as uint8 array

variants.R1: replace only L4/L5 using full-table8 dequantization
variants.R2: replace all xyz using full-table8 dequantization

evaluation.split: all20 official test frames in JSON order
evaluation.order: bouncingballs,hellwarrior,hook,jumpingjacks; R0,R1,R2 per scene, sequential fresh processes
evaluation.metrics: unchanged upstream metrics.py, PSNR and SSIM functions, LPIPS VGG; PNG uint8 round-trip and [0,1] RGB inputs as upstream, no new normalization
evaluation.timing: CUDA synchronized from deform.step start through gaussian_renderer.render end; loading/image I/O excluded; first frame reported separately, no unreported warmup
evaluation.VRAM: torch max allocated/reserved render process plus sampled total device if available

ratios: input_bytes/output_bytes (x); shares100*numerator/denominator; physical archive sizes, shared overhead counted once
H4: sealed historical gains only; no pair sums or subtraction from ZLIB
geometry: reuse verified CUDA scales from hook manifest only after exact matching level buffers/config; allocation formula from source/checkpoint; nominal vertices/capacity is theoretical, not empirical occupancy
